subject: ranger: handle float/integers overflow properly (#53501)
summary: Diff updates `pkg/util/ranger/ranger.go` `convertPoint` to ignore `types.ErrOverflow` not only for `DECIMAL`/`BIGINT`, but for all MySQL integer types and `FLOAT`, relying on existing boundary-clipping + `excl` adjustment + `validInterval` to keep produced ranges safe (no missed rows, at worst broader ranges). Adds planner plan-cache regression coverage in `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache_test.go` for out-of-range `BIGINT` constants and `FLOAT` comparisons where casting a large numeric string (e.g. `BIN(-1)`) overflows `FLOAT`. No plausible Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found, and later history up to `upstream/master` shows no follow-up changes to this overflow-handling branch.
